waypoints.name: Esmeralda Basin / Ingalls Lake Trailhead (North Fork Teanaway Rd, FR 9737)
waypoints.note: DB currently lists Stuart Lake TH (Eightmile Creek Rd) — appears to be an error; this specific 'Upper' route variant is guided/documented via the Ingalls Lake side to skip the lower ridge
waypoints.directions: From I-90 Exit 85, take Highway 970 east 7 miles to Teanaway Road, then bear right onto the North Fork Teanaway Road — 22.5 miles in total — to the Esmeralda Basin / Ingalls Lake Trailhead at the end of FR 9737, about 4,240 ft. Make sure you are driving to the Teanaway side: this route is also listed against the Stuart Lake Trailhead on Eightmile Creek Road, on the far side of the range, but this upper-ridge variant is the one documented from the Ingalls Lake side. The Ingalls Way trail leaves from the parking area.

waypoints.name: Top of Sherpa Glacier notch
waypoints.note: Ascend Sherpa Glacier to this notch to gain the upper North Ridge, bypassing the lower ridge's early pitches.
